intro: Parana is quiet power. It reclines gently, supports completely, and adapts to how you feel—without ever making a sound.

features.title: Personal comfort, manual control
features.text: The manual recliner gives you freedom to move at your own pace, upto 134 degrees—no noise, no mechanics, just a moment to yourself.

features.title: Back support that listens
features.text: The high backrest and lumbar cushioning respond to your posture, helping you unwind without effort.

features.title: A seat that restores
features.text: With full-body cushioning and a chaise to stretch out, Parana makes it easy to switch off and recharge.

features.title: We focus softness where it matters
features.text: With rich half-leather upholstery at all touchpoints, Parana brings comfort right where your body meets the recliner—durable on the outside, soft on the inside.

features.title: Foot support that flows with you
features.text: The built-in footrest extends as you recline, giving your legs the stretch and support they need without extra effort.

features.title: Curved to follow your natural form
features.text: Gently rounded armrests are shaped to support relaxed shoulders and natural posture—so you feel at ease the moment you settle in.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Parana L Shape Leather Manual Recliner Sofa
